integrity: The proof was reconstructed at the functional level, including a common decoder for the full cone family, both directions of Turing equivalence, the lower-bound obstruction for all infinite subsets of the core, and comparison with the closest known nonuniform cone lemma.
scientific_limitations: The cone base is the degree of the selected uniformly introreducible core and is not asserted to equal the degree of the original introenumerable set.
The construction is qualitative and gives no effective bound for obtaining decoder indices from an arbitrary presentation of the original set.
The 1968 foundational article was not fully accessible in the checked literature path, leaving a residual priority risk for older implicit coverage.
title: Uniform introreducibility spectra contain a full Turing cone
